signatures.description: Implement QUIC-style loss recovery over an abstract packet-number-space API: separate Initial/Handshake/Application spaces, ACK frame generation with range sets, PTO probe timeouts with exponential backoff, ECN-CE-triggered congestion response, and a pluggable congestion controller (NewReno plus a delivery-rate/BBR-style controller) driven by a supplied deterministic event trace. Acceptance: on the provided traces (heavy reordering, tail-loss, cross-space ACK during handshake+application overlap, persistent CE marks, and ACK-only flights) your recovery must never let an ACK for one space advance another space's largest-acked, must not arm a PTO while a new ACK is in flight, and must reproduce the expected retransmit counts shipped with each trace. Deliverable is a Go package plus a regression test that provably fails against a naive single-packet-number-space implementation.
